description: Fetch one codelist's code->label mapping by id, from any SDMX 2.1 registry, without needing a dataflow. Use this when you already know a codelist id (e.g. from sdmx_dataflow_structure's `codelist` field, or from a dataset's documentation) and just need the codes. Example: sdmx_codelist({ registry: "ilo", id: "CL_ECO" }) or sdmx_codelist({ registry: "eurostat", id: "GEO", filter: "France" }).

agency.description: Override the registry's default maintaining agency id for this codelist, e.g. "SDMX" for a shared CL_FREQ. Most callers can omit this.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on code id or label, e.g. "france", "quarterly".

registry.description: Which SDMX registry to query: eurostat, oecd, ecb, unsd, imf, bis, ilo, abs.

name: sdmx_codelist
title: Sdmx Codelist
